summary: Reuse the roll-completion key authority set until a grant or revocation arrives

replay.detail: The sorted grant and revocation claim IDs remain identical. Ordinary unrelated commits no longer reload their full history.

schema.detail: Two bounded seeks use the existing claims_kind_index. No index preparation, migration or store version change is needed.

rules.detail: The next authority read sees committed grants and revocations in its pinned snapshot; revoked claims remain part of the authority token.

compatibility.detail: No API, wire format or client changes.

downtime.detail: The in-memory set is initialized on first use after process start.

recovery.detail: Reopening the store rebuilds the in-memory set; binary rollback needs no migration.
